# Vendored Suraj Prasad source provenance

Source: [Jarus77/mats-nla-workspace@10d495f12fd63c434e8d9752f4a223ea59fa9d95](https://github.com/Jarus77/mats-nla-workspace/tree/10d495f12fd63c434e8d9752f4a223ea59fa9d95). Guiv confirmed Suraj Prasad's consent on 30 October 2026 at 19:41 CET. The complete tracked tree is included unmodified under `external/mats-nla-workspace/`: **6,088 files, 349,669,789 bytes**. `.git` is omitted. No upstream code was executed. No top-level licence file; included with author's permission. The nested third-party licence is preserved.

The earlier talk-number citation remains `4d43ecb2ef8f2cfab9d8ef673a1c7f56380460fd`. The later pin adds D51 corrections and exp 31. These are Suraj's author results, not independent replication; S16 was run by Guiv's agent on Suraj's pipeline.

## Copy and scan policy

This map supersedes the PR's earlier 5 MB/raw-tensor exclusions. Guiv authorized the complete pinned tree with a 50,000,000-byte per-file ceiling; no upstream file exceeds it, so no tracked upstream file is excluded. The five files above 10 MB are listed in [EXCLUSION_REVIEW](../EXCLUSION_REVIEW.md). The upstream Git tree is `600d5144139ab179d8f91b895063ce7a8b6a09df`; the staged vendored subtree matches it exactly, including executable modes.

Bank answers/labels are retained by explicit instruction. Operational-reference candidates with unconfirmed liveness and reviewed example/fixture credential-pattern false positives are disclosed in [EXCLUSION_REVIEW](../EXCLUSION_REVIEW.md). Scans have zero unresolved blocking findings under that documented policy; this is not a label-free or operational-metadata-free release. Binary screening is bounded raw-byte/archive-member inspection without tensor or pickle deserialization, and is not image OCR. No endpoint was contacted to test liveness.

The file-hash list below covers upstream files only; `external/README.md` is the release wrapper and is covered by the external tree digest in root PROVENANCE. The matching [checksum file](mats-nla-workspace.sha256) can be checked from the repository root with `shasum -a 256 -c docs/provenance/mats-nla-workspace.sha256`; that command hashes files without executing upstream code.
